messages.author: player4
messages.content:
Yes, but it would need to be highly specific to be allowed to apply to combat roll.  

Here are some examples of things I'd allow (this isn't mean to be an exhaustive list but is meant to give an idea of how specific it would need to be in order to be allowed to be taken for a combat skill):
* an extra +10 (on top of the normal bonus) when attacking someone you've ambushed and taken by surprise
* an extra +10 (on top of the normal bonus) when spending an extra action to aim your arrow when taking a shot
* an extra +10 (on top of the normal bonuses) while surrounding a target

I'd allow any of those.  But it couldn't be like "specialization: spears" or whatever.

messages.author: player4
messages.content:
I actually am okay with that!

Brass knuckles are a 1k2 weapon.  If you take a specialization with them, you're basically saying "I get to use as 1k2 weapon as if it was a 3k2 weapon".

Which is not actually unbalanced.  It's situationally very useful because you're basically saying "I get to use the same damage as a spear or wakizashi while using a concealed weapon I can bring with me anywhere without raising alarm".

So that's both useful enough that it makes sense you'd want it, while not actually unbalancing the combat system.

Howdy.  I'd like to make a request.  Can we accumulate the various open threads and have a conversation in character or out about our priorities?  I'm getting a little overwhelmed about everything that we've started or noted for future activity and I'm not really certain which I need to put my thoughts into first.
1)  Shoda - I know this bounty is our immediate primary attention focus and I'm all for finishing this first.  I feel like we actually worked well as a team and planned to compliment everyone in character. (Ah, "woodcutter" is Shoda, I remembered the axe but not the "woodsman's" descriptor.)

2)  Fumito - Monk that led the group that might be protecting Shoda.  May need to interact with him later.

3) Fumitake - I still want to do research on his past bounties.  I'm not squaring his opulent life with his lack of effort.  He might just be making a lot of money handling bounties without the proper paperwork, but I also get the sense that he could be on the take.  I'm fine with this being a focus for just Sadakichi and I recognize we might not have had time to do the research, but I don't want this to get forgotten. ALSO, what Jack mentioned above about backing down from the Mantis.  I think I missed that.

4) Silk Stained Three - Have we stopped pursuing this?  Are we waiting on information from Fumitake or someone else?  Is the investigation into Shoda a detour on the way to doing somehting about this?

5) Otohime - Related to the above, I still wanted to look into this person to make sure the theft wasn't an inside job. Same caveats as Fumitake.

messages.author: player9
messages.content:
6) Yasuki Chizuru - I have rememberances of him being a sketchy bastard we may want to take down.  But I think we decided we would wait for the proper paperwork, so maybe he's not a concern for the immediate future.

7) Hida no Reiji Susano - Potential victim of Chizuru, but maybe we aren't doing anything for/about him at the moment.

8) Otsuki - Toshihiro's conversation might be the first time that we heard of this person.  However, unless he is related to some of the other people above, I don't know if we want to add him to our focus yet.

This might be everything but let me know if there's more.  I think after we deal with Shoda (with whatever result), then we should more clearly discuss our next move.
